name: Mecha-con!
source:
This is the debut game for onomatope*. A sudden change in law by the government ten years ago decreed that rich men must have multiple wives and father lots of children. Haruki’s parents passed away in a traffic accident and he inherited the family wealth while continuing to manage the Sakurajima business group. Even though he hasn’t had a girlfriend before, he now must propose to those girls that are closest to him.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
